name: Club bass swap
description: The club DJ's EQ mix. The next song comes in beat-matched with its bass switched off, so only its drums and melody are heard over the current song. On a chosen bar the basses swap in one quick move: the new bass rises over a beat or so and the old one is cut on the downbeat, and from then on only one bassline plays. Punchy and clean; made for dance music with a solid kick and bass at matching tempos.
author: Muisc
